actual_scope: Inside the existing F2[Q8] dirty-register model, a square i-call block n_i=t_i forces n_j>=2 t_i, up to trace parity. The inherited bound 5n>=11t is therefore never attained on the rays t_i=4 t_j and t_j=4 t_i: shape (4k,k) has no exact word of length 11k, so n>=11k+2, while the direct word costs 15k. At shape (7,1) the lemma excludes the relaxation witness (7,13); the 20-call splits (9,11), (11,9) and (13,7) remain open. No new alphabet and no new kappa.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue question asks whether a newly specified alphabet escapes the three-register obstruction. This package does not change the operation alphabet. It proves a square-block obstruction inside the already specified F2[Q8] model, aimed at the equality case and the (7,1) count witness left open by the shape-sensitive mixed-target bound. A local negative result may be retained without a supplier; no construction round is started.
bottleneck_link: Side result in the nonabelian register model. Removing unrealizable equality cases does not raise the selected conditional kappa 0.001672660197076918, and no physical caller or supplier admission is claimed.
stop_rule: Stop once the square-block image obstruction, the ray non-attainment n>=11k+2, and the (7,1) split list are proved and checked. Do not search the remaining 20-call splits and do not start a construction round.
evidence: PROOF.md, README.md and verify.py. Direct words for (4,1) and (7,1) with one dirty role; Sylvester through dimension 3; a non-identity unitriangular image fixture; the unique 11k split rejected for k=1..32; (7,13) rejected while three 20-call splits remain.
